g.title: nopr
g.text: the command: "No pull request for spike/x"

a.xlink:title: F02 load it in the background, once\nthe mode line says "💬 …"
a.text: F02 load it in the background, once

g.title: run
g.text: diff it against the buffer's text

g.title: show
g.text: threads as overlays, folded; a bubble in the right margin (D46):
unchanged line: under it · changed here: under the line
in its place, gold · deleted here: where it was, gold
outdated: where it was, dim · removed lines: between lines, ◂
whole file: above the first line
the mode line: 💬 and the file's threads (D50)

g.title: life
g.text: [user] edits → the overlays move with the text; once Emacs is idle,
the diff again (coalesced; an answer for older text is dropped)
HEAD moves (a commit, a checkout, a pull) → the branch's PR again (F22):
the same: the clone's state again · another: its threads · none: overlays go
D23's check (focus, timer) → ↻ in the mode line; [user] C-c ' g → F17
[user] C-c ' TAB · T, evil za zo zc zO zC · zR zM, mouse-1 on a bubble → unfold / fold
the line, or all; the line's innermost fold: zo zc where the threads are so
already, or without threads, and zO zC always, fold code as usual (D51)
the buffer's own folds change → a hidden line's threads go; the line that shows
the fold counts them in its bubble; a fold's first line's threads follow it
[user] C-c ' n / p (evil ]t / [t) → the next / previous unresolved
thread, unfolded, its folds opened; past the file's last, the PR's next file,
in the clone; past the last file, the first again
[user] C-c ' j → any thread of the PR, picked by completion, at its line
in the clone (another file opens there; not in the clone: the PR buffer)

g.title: act
g.text: [user] r R e k + on the line's threads
c s on the line or region

g.title: lines
g.text: c, s: every line as on
GitHub, and in the PR's diff?

g.title: why
g.text: comments only on its own lines", or
"… isn't in the pull request's diff"

a.xlink:title: F05 F06 F07 F08 F11\non GitHub's lines → F00
